stage2_patch.explanation: Replaced the no-op startup call `dvwaPageStartup( array( ) );` in setup.php with `dvwaPageStartup( array( 'authenticated' ) );`. This reuses DVWA's existing guard semantics defined in dvwa/includes/dvwaPage.inc.php, which checks dvwaIsLoggedIn() and, when the visitor is not authenticated, calls dvwaRedirect( DVWA_WEB_PAGE_TO_ROOT . 'login.php' ), matching every other protected page in the project (index.php, security.php, phpinfo.php, all vulnerabilities/*). The guard is placed immediately after the dvwaPage.inc.php include and before any page output, session token generation, or the state-changing 'create_db' database reset operation, so unauthenticated direct requests are denied and redirected before any sensitive work runs. Authenticated admin/authorized access is preserved, since dvwaIsLoggedIn() passes for logged-in users. No unrelated code was changed and existing includes and business logic are untouched.
